title: senecio neomexicanus var. mutabilis
intro: Senecio neomexicanus var. mutabilis, commonly known as New Mexican flameplant or changing colors flameplant, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Senecio neomexicanus var. mutabilis include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and potentially alleviate anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
